evidence: Implements BIP 54 soft fork consensus validation rules in src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and consensus headers.
rationale: The PR implements consensus rules resolving long-standing consensus hazards including legacy sigops computational DoS, timewarp attacks, and Merkle tree collisions. While restricted to regtest to unblock multi-node testing without immediate mainnet activation, proposed soft fork rules represent strategically critical consensus work that warrants deep, deliberate review.
